title: Workflow definitions: Discovery + Campaign DAGs
description: Define the two core Temporal-style workflow DAGs as Python dataclasses with typed activity steps. DiscoveryWorkflow: TrendAnalyst -> Scout -> persist candidates (cron 4x/day). CampaignWorkflow: Strategist -> WritersRoom -> SafetyPreCheck -> Producer -> SafetyPostCheck -> Publisher -> schedule MetricsPoll. Each activity is typed, idempotent, with configurable retry policy. Phase 1 uses in-process executor (no Temporal server required).
sub_tasks: Define WorkflowStep and WorkflowDAG base classes with typed I/O
Implement CampaignWorkflow DAG (Strategy -> Writers -> Safety -> Produce -> Publish -> Metrics)
Create InProcessExecutor that runs DAG steps sequentially with retry
Unit tests for DAG construction, step ordering, retry policy, idempotency
